items.prompt: A per-second Poisson-process rate is r and the modeled exposure lasts t seconds. Under that process model, what does lambda=rt represent?

options.text: A guaranteed count in every interval
The expected count over this exposure
options.why: The time unit and duration are part of the parameter contract.

options.text: The probability of exactly one event for every r,t
options.why: Expected count is not that event probability.

options.text: Proof that real observations have independent increments
options.why: A parameter formula does not validate the process assumptions.

items.explanation: Lambda is the modeled mean count for the whole exposure, not automatically the same number as a rate in another time unit.
